# ConvertMintTools

> Free browser-based unit converter tools. All conversions run entirely in the browser with no server call and no account required.

## Tools

- [Convert kg to lbs](https://convertminttools.com/convert-kg-to-lbs/): Convert kilograms to pounds with formula, worked example, and reference tables.
- [Convert lbs to kg](https://convertminttools.com/convert-lbs-to-kg/): Convert pounds to kilograms with formula, worked example, and reference tables.
- [Weight Converter](https://convertminttools.com/weight-converter/): Multi-unit weight hub (kg, g, mg, lb, oz, stone, metric ton, US ton).
- [Military Time Converter](https://convertminttools.com/military-time-converter/): Convert HHMM / HH:MM between 24-hour military time and 12-hour AM/PM.

## Scenario guides

- [lbs to kg body weight chart](https://convertminttools.com/lbs-to-kg-body-weight-chart/): 50-250 lb reference table with kilograms and UK stones.
- [lbs to kg luggage weight guide](https://convertminttools.com/lbs-to-kg-luggage-weight-guide/): Checked and carry-on limits for 10 major airlines.
- [lbs to kg gym weight plates](https://convertminttools.com/lbs-to-kg-gym-weight-plates/): Olympic bars, US lb plates, IWF kg plates, and common training loads.

## About

- [About ConvertMintTools](https://convertminttools.com/about/): How we calculate, which sources we follow (NIST, BIPM), and accuracy notes.
- [Contact](https://convertminttools.com/contact/): Report an issue, suggest a new converter, or send feedback.

## Formulas

- Weight: 1 kg = 2.2046226218 lb (international avoirdupois pound; NIST 1959 agreement; 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg exactly).
- Military time: 0000-2359 range; 0000 maps to 12:00 AM, 1200 to 12:00 PM, 1430 to 2:30 PM; 2400 is not a valid input.
